actuators._about: Off-the-shelf actuators we can buy (RobStride QDD modules). Sizes and torques from retailer listings (roboticscenter.ai, pakronics, openelab), not an official datasheet: confirm against the vendor's STEP and datasheet before ordering. 'r' is half the square flange size, 'h' the length along the output axis. 'ratio' > 1 means an extra linkage reduction after the module (torque x ratio, speed / ratio). Joint dynamics (tools/make_robot_files.py; 2026-10-31 ESTIMATES, not vendor data): 'gear' the module's reduction, 'rotor_kgm2' the motor rotor's inertia, scaled from the frame size against Unitree's 7520 motor (5e-5 kg m2, from G1's armature 0.0102 at 14.3:1); reflected at the output as armature = rotor x gear^2; 'damping_nms' viscous and 'friction_nm' Coulomb friction at the output, typical of QDD modules (friction about 2-3 % of peak torque).
